name: io.github.m-sanchez/calibration-explorer
title: Calibration Explorer
description: Check classifier confidence against accuracy, fit temperature scaling and save local reports.

packageArguments.name: --input-root
packageArguments.description: Existing absolute directory whose prediction CSV or JSON files the server may read. Paths outside it are refused. Repeat for more directories.

packageArguments.name: --output-root
packageArguments.description: Existing absolute directory where the server may create new report folders. It never overwrites files. Repeat for more directories.
